description: This file contains the implementation of ImmersiveActivity, which manages immersive mode UI in an Android application, including hiding and showing system UI elements with user interactions.

classes.name: ImmersiveActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that manages immersive full-screen UI mode, toggling visibility of system UI elements based on user gestures and activity lifecycle events.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up views, gesture detectors, and system UI change listeners.

methods.name: onWindowFocusChanged
methods.description: Responds to window focus changes to hide the system UI when the activity gains focus.

methods.name: hideSystemUI
methods.description: Sets system UI flags to hide navigation and status bars for immersive mode.

methods.name: showSystemUI
methods.description: Sets system UI flags to show navigation and status bars.

methods.name: delayedHide
methods.description: Schedules the hiding of the system UI after a specified delay.
